At Commuty we’re making parking & commuting smarter for companies. We help employees organize their workday in the most efficient, happy and green way! In 5 years, we worked for many types of companies, from small to big ones, such as AG Insurance, Social Lab, L’Oréal or UCB.

We have ambitious goals for the coming months, and we need ambitious new team mates to reach them. We’d love your help here! You don’t focus on closing business, but connecting with as many leads as possible ( inbound and outbound) and determining if they’re good customer fits. We will need you to help us move these leads through the sales pipeline. You will work hand in hand with the marketing team and you will be a fueling the pipe and the sales team with great leads.

You will be helping for - contact every lead and determine who stays and who goes. - educate, answer questions, and send resources to potential customers. - Qualify leads and move them through the sales process.

REQUIREMENTS Organization and time management Resilience and determination Great at making first contact Conversational skills Proactive and autonomous Excellent interpersonal skills Rigorous and methodical (results-driven & documentation) Be super fluent in English, and native in French and/or Dutch.

WHAT YOU WILL GET Tremendous growth opportunities Be a part of a dynamic team focused on taking Commuty to the next level Cool work environment that is caring, fun, and collaborative Office in Louvain-la-Neuve & Brussels, with a strong culture of remote work A salary package in line with your experience and skills Last but not least, the satisfaction of making a positive impact on society and employee well-being ‍ A WORD ABOUT COMMUTY Commuty is a Belgian startup founded 6 years ago with the powerful will to make a difference and address environmental challenges of our society.

Our 1st focus is the workplace: we develop a software to improve parking & desk management and boost green mobility in companies & office buildings. We make complex workplace issues become super easy to deal with, thanks to digitization and innovation.

At the end of the day, we help employees organize their workday in the most efficient, happy and green way! INTERESTED? Apply ! ## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
· Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
· Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
· Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
· Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
· Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
· Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
· Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
· Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
· Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
· Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
· Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
· Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
· Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
· Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

· 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
· Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
· Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
· Able to work autonomously and independently
· Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
· Comfortable working European timezone hours
· Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
· Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
· Comfortable using AI in workflow

· Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
· Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
· Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
· Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
· A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
· A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
· First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
· Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
· Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

· Remote, travel encouraged
· Credits for Outsite locations
· Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

The Reality of This Role This is not a "relationship management" role or a "check-the-box" administrative position. We are looking for a pure hunter who thrives on the road and views a "No" as a tactical puzzle to be solved. If you require a desk, a steady routine, or a manager to tell you who to call next, do not apply.

Who You Are (The Top 10%) Self-Governed: You don’t need a GPS to find a target. You own your territory like it’s your own franchise. Fluent in Results: You don't brag about how many "calls" you made; you brag about the revenue you closed.

Resilient: You have the "softball" mentality for people—gentle enough to build instant rapport—but the "hardball" mentality for the deal. Elite Communicator: You possess near-native command of English (C1/C2 level) and preferably one or more European languages to negotiate with C-suite executives and navigate complex objections.

The Mission (Days on Road) 80% Field Presence: You will spend 4 days a week on the road. You will be expected to master your territory through face-to-face combat—meeting prospects where they live and work. Strategic Hunting: You will identify, qualify, and close high-value accounts independently. Full Accountability: You manage your own pipeline.

We provide the CRM; you provide the data that shows why you’re winning. What We Offer (The Upside) Uncapped Commissions: We don't believe in "ceiling" your success. If you bring in the revenue, you keep the lion's share. Zero Micro-Management: We don't care where you are at 10:00 AM as long as your numbers are at 120% of quota.

High-Stakes Environment: You will be surrounded by other high-performers. If you are the smartest person in the room, you are in the wrong room. Requirements Proven Track Record: You can provide a 12-month stack-ranking showing you in the top decile of your previous sales force.

Mobility: A European driving licence and a willingness to be "on the road" constantly. Stamina: Physical and mental endurance for long days and high-pressure negotiations. Fully Remote, Europe Originally posted on Himalayas

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.
Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.
Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

About League
League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call.

That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale.

Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America.
Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines.
League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.
What You'll Own
Account research and point of view
Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews.
Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement.
Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot.
Outreach and pipeline creation
Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls.
Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls.
Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate.
The system itself
Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team.
Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging.
Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record.
Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression.

Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities.
Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements.
Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations.
Comply with Information Security Policies.

Two+ years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure.
A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career.
Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers.
Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on.
Strong written communication.
Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it.
Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles.
Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy.
Helpful, not required
Exposure to payers, health systems, benefits administrators or consumer health organizations.
Familiarity with Star Ratings, HEDIS, care gaps, benefits navigation and digital front door.
Experience with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, Artisan or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Experience building your own AI workflows, skills or agents.
How You Work
Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating:
You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you.
You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly..
You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack.
You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce.
You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning.
You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on.
You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively.
You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team.
You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you.
What Success Looks Like
Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves.
Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification.
The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built.
You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living.
You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts.

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. We ship AWS modernization to production in weeks, data platforms migrated, legacy applications and databases refactored, AI agents running against real data, for mid-market and lower-enterprise companies in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, internet and software, manufacturing, and TMEGS.
Our delivery model is built around AI agents that absorb the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, schema mapping, validation, test generation, cutover rehearsal, that traditional consulting bills against human hours. Forward-deployed engineers work on top of those agents, embedded with the customer's team, owning architecture, judgment, and cutover. We commit to a fixed delivery date on a fixed fee. If we slip for reasons inside our control, the cost sits with us.
Most modernization doesn't ship. Ours does. That is the entire pitch.
You'll be the named Mactores contact for AWS sales teams across US territories. AWS account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers each carry a partner deck full of firms that all say roughly the same thing. Your job is to make them see Mactores as the agent-native firm in that mix, the one they route to when their customer needs a modernization program finished, not staffed.
What you'll sell maps directly to what AWS reps care about: we're MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and predictable on fixed-date engagements. Our founders built the agent platform we deploy, so deployment depth is a structural advantage and AWS reps make money when we win. The conversation starts on the same side of the table.
You won't run deep technical demos, a forward-deployed engineer does that. You set up the meeting, frame the customer's problem, walk through the agent-native approach in business terms, anchor everything in shipped case studies, and hand off to the FDE when the conversation reaches architecture. Then you close the loop: register the opportunity, keep the AWS rep informed, push the deal forward.
This is not a script-and-cadence BDR seat. AWS reps see hundreds of partner BDRs. The ones who get traction can hold a real conversation about the customer's modernization problem, not run through a sequence.

Build coverage across AWS US sales territories: account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers (Data, AI/ML, Modernization).
Reach out, follow up, show up at AWS Summits and regional partner events, and build named relationships.
Walk AWS reps through what agent-native AWS modernization means in practice and why it's different from what every other partner in their deck says.
Anchor every conversation in shipped Mactores case studies: named customer, named baseline, named outcome, time-to-value, cost reduction.
Identify customer fit, frame the business problem, articulate Mactores' business value, and tee up the technical demo.
Hand off to the forward-deployed engineer for the architecture walkthrough. Your job is to make sure the FDE walks into a qualified room.
Source Amazon-originated opportunities into the Mactores pipeline, register them in ACE, and keep the AWS rep in the loop through cycle close.
Feed market signal back to Mactores leadership, what AWS reps hear from customers, where the partner conversation is shifting, and which messaging lands.

3–5 years in a BDR, SDR, or partner-development role, with a demonstrated ability to source qualified pipeline from a cold start.
Comfort talking to AWS field teams. Prior work at an AWS partner, exposure to AWS Partner Central, ACE, or MAP, and time on the floor at AWS Summits or re:Invent are preferred, not required but they shorten the ramp.
Comfort with the technical concepts of cloud modernization, data platforms, and agentic AI without being the engineer in the room. You can read an architecture diagram, talk through a case study, and name where the customer's pain is. You don't need to debug a Lambda.
Sharp business-value articulation: you can take a messy customer problem statement, restate it in two sentences, and show how Mactores ships against it.
A self-managed work style. Remote role, distributed AWS field, no daily stand-up babysitting your activity.
Travel roughly 30% across the US AWS offices, customer sites, AWS Summits, re:Invent, and regional partner events.
How we work?
We're not selling a roadmap. Our agents run in production today, and our forward-deployed engineers ship with them every day. Mactores is MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and holds seven AWS Consulting Competencies and seventeen Service Validations, the credentials that make an AWS rep's routing decision easy.
The agent-native category window is 6–12 months. After that, "agent-native" becomes commodity vocabulary the way "cloud-native" did. We're on the early side of that window, and the BDR who plants the flag in AWS field conversations now will own those relationships when the category gets loud. You'll join an existing partnership and sales motion, the system works. Your job is to add territory coverage and AWS-originated pipeline to it, not invent the function from scratch.
How you'll be measured
A combination of net-new logos and AWS-originated revenue. Not call counts, not email volume, not meetings booked for their own sake. The leading indicator is qualified AWS-sourced pipeline. The lagging indicator is closed-won revenue from customers who came in through the AWS field. Quota structure and targets are discussed in the interview process.

s.t:
Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird, sondern wie und mit wem.
Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater begleiten wir energetische Sanierungen ganzheitlich — von der ersten Frage bis zur installierten Wärmepumpe oder PV-Anlage. 2025 haben wir dieses Wissen konsequent in den Vertrieb gebracht: jedes Haus ein Einzelfall, jede Lösung passgenau. Mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und 80 Mitarbeitenden wachsen wir in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.
Unser Vertriebsinnendienst ist in den letzten zwei Jahren von einer Handvoll Leuten zu einem festen Team gewachsen. Die Zahlen stimmen. Was fehlt, ist jemand, der das Team führt, entwickelt und aus einer eingespielten Truppe ein System macht, das auch das nächste Wachstum trägt.
Unser Angebot
85.000 € Zielgehalt, davon 55.000 € Grundgehalt. Dein variabler Anteil hängt an der Leistung Deines Teams, nicht an Deiner eigenen Anwahlliste
Ein Team, das steht: keine Wackelkandidaten, keine Sanierungsaufgabe. Du übernimmst Leute, die liefern, und holst mehr raus
Direkter Draht zum Head of Sales, kurze Wege, echte Entscheidungsspielräume. Die Prozesse für Dein Team baust Du selbst
Wir stellen weiter ein. Dein Team wächst, während Du es führst
Zwei Tage Homeoffice, drei Tage Büro in Kreuzberg — Coaching am Hörer funktioniert nur live
Dein Spielfeld
Du führst das Pre-Sales-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch: Coaching am Hörer, Call-Reviews, 1:1s, Entwicklungspläne
Du steuerst über Zahlen — Speed to Lead, Anwahlfrequenz, Booking-Rate, Show-Rate, Conversion in Abschlüsse. Und Du erkennst, ob hinter einer Zahl ein Prozess klemmt oder jemand im Team Unterstützung braucht
Du baust die Grundlagen: Gesprächsleitfäden, Einwandbehandlung, Onboarding für neue Leute, Dokumentation, die auch funktioniert, wenn Du im Urlaub bist
Du gestaltest die Verschiebung unseres Provisionsmodells von Volumen zu Qualität mit. Wir sind von 70/30 auf 50/50 gegangen und wollen auf 30/70. Gleiche Frequenz, härterer Qualitätsanspruch: Ein Termin zählt für Dein Team erst richtig, wenn daraus ein Abschluss wird
Du pitchst selbst. Nicht jeden Tag, aber oft genug, dass Dein Team weiß, dass Du es kannst
So passt du in's Team
Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre ein Vertriebsteam von sechs oder mehr Leuten geführt — Inside Sales, SDR, Terminierung, Telefonvertrieb. Die erste Führungsrolle ist diese hier nicht
Du kommst selbst aus dem Vertrieb und hast Zahlen verantwortet, bevor Du sie von anderen eingefordert hast
Du arbeitest mit Daten statt mit Bauchgefühl: Du kannst benennen, welche Kennzahl Du in Deinem letzten Team bewegt hast, um wie viel, und was Du dafür konkret geändert hast
Du schreibst Dinge auf. Prozesse, Entscheidungen, Leitfäden — nicht weil es jemand verlangt, sondern weil Du weißt, was sonst passiert
Du führst über Verbindlichkeit, nicht über Lautstärke. Und Du kannst beides: Ansprüche stellen und Leute dort abholen, wo sie stehen

Spreeblick statt Hinterhof: unser Büro liegt direkt am Wasser, mitten in Kreuzberg
Zwei Remote-Tage pro Woche, der Rest live mit dem Team
Ein Learning-Budget, das auf Deine Entwicklung einzahlt – fachlich oder querbeet
Urban Sports Club, Jobticket, Kita-Zuschuss – je nachdem, was in Deinem Leben gerade zählt
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Du begleitest Menschen dabei, ihre Häuser nachhaltiger zu machen – Energiewende zum Anfassen

This role defines the vision, roadmap, governance, and activation of data across channels, platforms, and markets to enable privacy-compliant personalization, stronger measurement, predictive insights, and improved marketing performance at global scale.

Working with internal teams and external partners, the role will build robust data foundations and AI-ready capabilities that turn consumer data into continuous intelligence for more precise engagement, optimized spend, and sustained business impact.

Verkaufsberater/in Deutschschweiz – HORECA und Fachhandel (Heimarbeit)
Die AVY sucht eine Verkaufspersönlichkeit für die Deutschschweiz: eine Person, die langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut, die Weine aus Yvorne glaubwürdig vertritt und unsere Präsenz in Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Sommellerie und Fachhandel gezielt weiterentwickelt.
Über die AVY
Die AVY, Artisans Vignerons d’Yvorne, wurde 1902 gegründet und ist eine traditionsreiche Winzergenossenschaft im Waadtländer Chablais. Sie vinifiziert und vermarktet die Produktion ihrer 120 Mitglieder, hauptsächlich unter der renommierten Appellation Yvorne Chablais AOC.
Die AVY verbindet Tradition, Qualität und Modernität. Sie bewirtschaftet und valorisiert ein einzigartiges Terroir und produziert eine vielfältige Palette von Weinen: Chasselas, Rotweine, weisse Spezialitäten und zeitgemässe Kreationen. Die Qualität der AVY\-Weine wird regelmässig anerkannt und ausgezeichnet.
Die AVY ist in der Deutschschweiz bereits präsent und möchte ihre kommerzielle Entwicklung in diesem Markt gezielt verstärken, insbesondere in Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Sommellerie und Fachhandel.
Ihre Aufgabe
Ihre Aufgabe ist es, die kommerzielle Präsenz der AVY in der Deutschschweiz weiterzuentwickeln. Sie eröffnen neue Kundenbeziehungen, bauen bestehende und neue Kontakte langfristig aus und stärken die Sichtbarkeit sowie die Distribution der AVY\-Weine in einem anspruchsvollen und dynamischen Markt.
Sie verstehen sich als Botschafter/in der Weine aus Yvorne: Sie können Geschichte, Herkunft, Identität und Qualität der AVY\-Weine überzeugend vermitteln und zugleich mit den konkreten Bedürfnissen von Gastronomie, Sommellerie und Fachhandel verbinden.
Diese Rolle verlangt nicht nur Leidenschaft für Wein, sondern auch kommerzielle Disziplin: Akquise, konsequente Nachverfolgung, Portfolioaufbau, zuverlässige CRM\-Nutzung und die Fähigkeit, Vertrauen im Markt Schritt für Schritt aufzubauen.
Über den Verkauf hinaus übernehmen Sie eine beratende Rolle gegenüber den Kunden. Sie verstehen deren Positionierung, schlagen passende Sortimente vor, unterstützen die Weiterempfehlung und den Wiederverkauf der Weine und bringen relevante Marktinformationen zurück zur AVY.
Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie insbesondere folgende Aufgaben:
Weiterentwicklung der kommerziellen Präsenz der AVY in der Deutschschweiz bei HORECA, Sommellerie und Fachhandel.
Identifikation, Qualifikation und Ansprache neuer Kunden mit Potenzial, im Einklang mit der Positionierung und den Prioritäten der AVY.
Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Restaurateuren, Hoteliers, Sommeliers, Vinotheken, Fachhändlern und weiteren kommerziellen Partnern.
Aktives Zuhören und saubere Bedarfserhebung, bevor Sie ein Angebot unterbreiten.
Verständnis der Positionierung, Bedürfnisse und Rahmenbedingungen jedes Kunden, um passende Sortimente und Lösungen vorzuschlagen.
Übersetzung der Eigenschaften eines Weins in konkreten Nutzen für den Kunden: Weinkarte, Sortiment, Preispositionierung, Marge, Gästeerlebnis, Identität des Hauses oder Wiederverkaufspotenzial.
Professionelle und überzeugende Präsentation der AVY\-Weine, mit Fokus auf Herkunft, Geschichte, Qualität und kommerzieller Relevanz.
Unterstützung der Kunden bei der Präsentation und dem Wiederverkauf der AVY\-Weine, unter anderem durch Degustationen, Sortimentsberatung, Verkaufsargumente und gezielte Aktionen.
Zuverlässige kommerzielle Nachverfolgung: Angebote, Follow\-ups, Verhandlungen, Bestellungen, Kundeninformationen und nächste Schritte.
Verlässliche Nutzung des CRM und digitaler Werkzeuge zur Dokumentation von Opportunitäten, Kundenportfolio und Marktinformationen.
Regelmässige Rückmeldung von Marktbeobachtungen: Kundenerwartungen, Konsumtrends, Wettbewerb, Preise, Einwände und Chancen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem internen Team, um eine professionelle, kohärente und zuverlässige Kundenerfahrung sicherzustellen.
Ihr Profil
Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine selbständige, strukturierte und resultatorientierte Persönlichkeit mit echtem Interesse an Wein, Menschen und langfristigen Geschäftsbeziehungen.
Sie hören zuerst zu, bevor Sie verkaufen. Sie möchten den Kunden, seinen Betrieb, sein Sortiment, seine Zwänge und seine Ziele verstehen. Sie können Vertrauen aufbauen, glaubwürdig beraten und ein Weinhaus authentisch vertreten.
Erfahrung im Wein\-, Getränke\-, Gastronomie\-, Hotellerie\- oder Fachhandelsumfeld ist ein grosser Vorteil. Ebenso wichtig sind für uns jedoch Persönlichkeit, Zuhören können, Verlässlichkeit, Lernbereitschaft und die Fähigkeit, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.

Dokument**Einleitungssatz**
## ##
Unsere versierten Mitarbeitenden in der Betriebsführung steuern die Anlage rund um die Uhr und sorgen für einen störungsfreien Betrieb des Kraftwerks. Nutzen Sie die Gelegenheit und starten Sie bei uns die mehrjährige Ausbildung zum Pikettingenieur.
## **Was Sie erwartet:** ##
* Eine systematische Weiterbildung vom Anlagen- bzw. Reaktoroperateur über den Schichtchef bis zum Pikettingenieur. Die Weiterbildung im Betrieb der Anlage umfasst sowohl fachtechnische Inhalte als auch Führungskompetenzen. Sie findet intern im Ressort Ausbildung und am eigenen Simulator statt sowie extern an der Nukleartechnikerschule in Baden (http://www.kernenergie.ch/).
* Als Pikettingenieur werden Sie vom Schichtleiter zugezogen, wenn das Anlageverhalten vom Normalzustand abweicht und unterstützen situativ mit Ihrer Expertise.
* In Ihrer Funktion als Pikettingenieur nehmen Sie regelmässig an Weiterbildungskursen sowie vielseitigen Simulatorschulungen teil und übernehmen gleichzeitig Verantwortung in einem technischen Fachbereich.
## **Was Sie auszeichnet:** ##
* Sie haben ein Fachhochschulstudium im Bereich Elektro- oder Maschineningenieurwesen oder ein Ingenieurstudium an einer technischen Hochschule erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
* Sie zeichnen sich durch Ihre Bereitschaft zur intensiven Aus- und Weiterbildung aus. Das ideale Einstiegsalter liegt zwischen 25 und 35 Jahren.
* Herausfordernde, neue und wechselnde Situationen bewältigen Sie überlegt, flexibel und fachkundig.
* Sie sind ein Teamplayer, übernehmen aber auch gekonnt den Lead und leiten sowie begleiten Ihr Team in normalen wie auch besonderen Situationen professionell.
* Sie schätzen die Vorzüge der Schichtarbeit (3-Schichtbetrieb) während der Ausbildung und die Bereitschaft zu unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten und Pikettdiensten (inkl. Nacht- und Wochenenddienste).
* Sprachkenntnisse: Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend notwendig, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
## **Was wir bieten:** ##
* Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten, technisch versierten und verantwortungsbewussten Unternehmen
* Gezielte Förderung von Fachkenntnissen und Kompetenzen
* Marktgerechte Löhne kombiniert mit einem attraktiven Paket an zusätzlichen Leistungen
* Hervorragende Pensionskassenlösungen zur Absicherung der Zukunft
* Genussvolle Verpflegung im firmeneigenen Personalrestaurant
* Ein Arbeitsumfeld, das von gegenseitigem Respekt, Teamgeist und einer offenen Kommunikationskultur geprägt ist.
Sie sind technisch versiert, lieben Herausforderungen und möchten dabei mitwirken, dass alles reibungslos läuft - dann suchen wir genau Sie! Als Pikettingenieur übernehmen Sie Verantwortung und stellen mit Ihrem Fachwissen sowie Ihrem Engagement sicher, dass unsere Anlage rund um die Uhr zuverlässig funktioniert.
Für weitere Auskünfte steht Ihnen Stefan Waldmeier, Leiter Betriebsführung, gerne zur Verfügung.

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) in our dynamic, fast-paced team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our growth pipeline and expanding our market reach.

The primary responsibility of this role is to engage high-potential leads, articulate the value of our healthcare platform, address objections, and ultimately convert prospects into qualified opportunities.

You will serve as the first point of contact for potential clients or users, providing technical and program overviews, answering complex questions, and scheduling them for formal consultations or onboarding sessions with our account management and care teams.

Lead Generation & Qualification: Initiate high-volume outbound cold/warm calls and promptly respond to inbound inquiries to identify and qualify potential opportunities.
Value Proposition & Pitching: Educate prospective clients or users on the program, emphasizing core benefits and features, effectively handling objections, and driving conversions.
Pipeline Management: Ensure timely, disciplined follow-up with all warm leads and prospects expressing interest to build trust and maximize conversion rates.
Technical Onboarding: Assist prospects in navigating our platform application and/or website, troubleshooting initial technical hurdles to ensure a seamless onboarding experience.
Data Integrity: Accurately record and maintain critical prospect information, qualification details, and detailed call notes within our CRM system.
Quota Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and pipeline targets.
Content Delivery: Strategic distribution of educational and marketing materials to interested prospects through email and other digital communication channels.
Market Expertise: Stay informed about industry trends, developments in cardiac rehabilitation, and internal product updates to optimize pitch effectiveness.

Start-up Agility: Ability to thrive and adapt quickly in a fast-paced, evolving start-up environment.
Quota-Driven Performance: Proven experience working in a metrics-driven, quota-bearing environment with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.

Sales Acumen: Experience engaging with customers or clients in a direct sales, inside sales, or telephonic outreach capacity.
High EQ/IQ: Exceptional communication skills with a high emotional intelligence required to navigate complex customer conversations and objections effortlessly.
Tech-Savvy: Proficient in leveraging modern technology, CRMs (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), and communication tools in a professional setting.
